name: Tang Dynasty  Mysteries: The Poison Conspiracy
overview: Newly arrived constable Wei Tao is thrust into a baffling poison case when eight elders from a local charity die under mysterious circumstances. His investigation leads him to widow-physician Jiao Yu, where buried secrets and deadly traps begin to surface.
